observations: Photo shows a car interior/exterior panel or trim piece with visible text 'HONDA' and 'ACURA' on it.
No engine, suspension components, or body parts are clearly shown in the photo—only a single panel/trim piece.

claims.claim: Engine, suspension and body parts for all model of acura and honda cars and suvs
claims.evidence: Only one small panel/trim piece is visible; no engine/suspension parts are shown.
No shipping documents, labels, or markings indicating Belgium origin are visible.

claims.claim: Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened
claims.evidence: No engine is shown, and there is no test video, sound recording, or odometer/engine code evidence.

risks.risk: The item shown may not be the engine/suspension claimed; could be only a trim/panel or unrelated part.
risks.proof: Ask for clear photos of the exact engine/suspension parts (front/back, engine block, mounting points) and a photo of the full set being sold.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a non-matching/partial part (worst case: not the engine/suspension), at the lowest category value for the visible panel/trim.

risks.risk: Compatibility risk: even if it’s an Acura/Honda part, it may not fit the buyer’s exact model/year/engine variant.
risks.proof: Ask for the part number(s) and fitment list (make/model/year/engine) plus a photo of the stamped/label part number.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic/uncertain fit (worst case: may not fit), reducing value accordingly.

risks.risk: Condition risk: 'tested and working' cannot be verified without engine/suspension testing evidence.
risks.proof: Request a short video of the engine running (cold start if possible) and/or suspension test (movement/inspection) plus any diagnostic scan screenshot.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven (worst case: assume not working/unknown condition).

risks.risk: Origin/“tokunbo” risk: claim may be marketing; without documents it can’t be trusted.
risks.proof: Request import documents or a photo of any label/marking and the container/receipt details.
risks.if_unproven: Price without tokunbo premium (worst case: treated as used locally/unknown origin).

proof_requests: Send photos that clearly show the actual engine and/or suspension components being sold (not just a panel), including close-ups of engine block and mounting areas.
Provide part numbers (stamped/label) and fitment by make/model/year/engine variant.
Send a video proof: engine start + running sound (no knock) and/or diagnostic scan screenshot.
Provide proof of Belgium origin (import documents or clear labels/receipts).
response.reason: The photo only shows a Honda/Acura-labeled panel/trim piece, while the seller claims engines and suspension parts with specific condition/origin. Without clear images of the claimed components and test evidence, a reliable price cannot be set.
